connectors.name: card0-DP-1
connectors.note: real UGREEN-dock TV (Samsung QCQ95S) connector. edid-decode confirms VIC 118: 3840x2160 120Hz IS present (true 4K120 over the dock) AND DMT 0x1c: 1280x800 59.81Hz 16:10 is ALSO a valid EDID-declared fallback timing -- the raw /sys modes file (resolution-only, no Hz) cannot distinguish these. IMPORTANT: this means the D6 incident mode (1280x800@60) is NOT absent from the EDID mode list -- it is a standard VESA/DMT compatibility timing the TV declares but cannot usefully display at its native 4K panel; the black-screen root cause is a valid-per-EDID-but-wrong-for-this-sink mode, not a nonexistent one. See edid-card0-DP-1.decoded.txt.
